description: After my previous role, I took on freelance projects where I worked on developing WordPress page, web maintenance, and helping projects for small clients. In the meantime, I’ve been staying up to date on the latest industry practices, attending webinars, enrolling in web development bootcamp, and working on personal development projects to ensure I remain technically proficient.

Developed web-based Customer Service forms and applications to streamline business operations. Designed and implemented centralized landing page, with single sign-on for clients. Collaborated with teams to deliver functional enhancements based on Agile methodologies. Utilized ASP.NET Core alongside ASP.NET Framework, Web Form, and SQL Server for development.
Working under Glints as a Full-Stack .NET Developer on the internal website.
Working with an internal team of XMU for Employee Self-service modules.
